literal: Auspiciousness, they say, is household excellence; and its good ornament is obtaining good children.
translation: They say the excellence of a wife is the true blessing of a household, and the gift of good children is its finest ornament.
modern: மனைவியின் நற்பண்புகளே குடும்பத்திற்கு மங்கலம் என்று அறிஞர் கூறுவர்; நல்ல பிள்ளைகளைப் பெறுவதே அந்த மங்கலத்திற்குச் சிறந்த அணிகலன் ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the true wealth of family life. The word 'மங்கலம்' refers to the auspiciousness or fundamental blessing of a home, which is identified as the noble character of the wife ('மனைமாட்சி'). Furthermore, the couplet states that the crowning ornament ('நன்கலம்') to this blessing is the gift of bearing good children ('நன்மக்கள்'). Together, a virtuous spouse and good children complete the joy and purpose of domestic life.
